lines.text: What I thought was going to be a sophisticated campus drama ended up being so much more! It felt like watching from above and then suddenly zooming in so close that I could feel the tension, discomfort, and longing. Although it’s a slow build to get to know each character’s place in the story, it was well worth the page-turning all the way to the end!
